Class CodeRefinementBatch

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.toolkit.resources.text.AbstractTextResourceWrite
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.tools.java.coderefiner.CodeRefinementBatch
public class CodeRefinementBatch extends AbstractTextResourceWrite
An atomic batch of member-level CodeRefinementIntents applied to a single Java file by BatchCodeRefiner#refine.

Extends AbstractTextResourceWrite to participate in the interactive diff UI lifecycle, optimistic locking, and manual override capture.

Author:
anahata

  • Method Details

    • doCalculateResultingContent

      protected String doCalculateResultingContent(Agi agi) throws Exception
      Performs the actual, tool-specific calculation of the resulting content.

      Replays the refinement intents in-memory on a dummy PsiJavaFile created via PsiFileFactory, shortens class references, optionally optimizes imports, and reformats code without mutating workspace files until committed.

      Specified by:
      doCalculateResultingContent in class AbstractTextResourceWrite
      Parameters:
      agi - The parent agi session.
      Returns:
      The calculated resulting content as a String.
      Throws:
      Exception - if the calculation logic fails.
